column1: # Vendored skills and where they came from. Read by ./skills-check.sh.
#   upstream-path    skill folder inside that repo
#   adopted-commit   upstream commit the local copy was taken from (blank if unknown)
#   recorded-hash    upstream folder hash at that commit (blank if unknown)
# An empty adopted-commit means no upstream version ever matched the local folder,
# so the local copy is a rewrite or never came from that path. The check reports
# those as "unknown-baseline" instead of guessing behind vs edited.
# Folders in .agents/skills that are absent here are hand-written and are not checked.
